reviews.title: Very dodgy business and terrible value for money
reviews.text:
After paying something over $200AUD per year for a subscription to this app (which I use to send not even 120 invoices a year) they changed their terms right before my subscription ticked over to limit the number of invoices to 10 per month, jacked the price up AND tried to force me onto a ‘premium plan’ that would come to almost double what I was already paying. I invoice by the quarter and don’t exceed the limit they created. They have support agents (once you ask for a human - the default is an AI bot which is absolutely useless) who give completely opposite advice and will override the system one month but tell you it’s impossible to the next month. Highly highly dodgy and on top of that, not even a particularly good app! 

When you try and have an issue resolved they palm you off to Apple. 

Honestly do not waste your money or your time on this app!

reviews.title: App is now too expensive for small businesses
reviews.text: I’ve used Invoice Simple for years and years and it was great but with the major app increases in Australia, it’s now too expensive compared to other invoice apps. I have been trying out other invoice apps at a lower price and yes they far better actually and at a fraction of what Invoice Simple now charge. Do a bit of research everyone, there is far better cost saving invoice apps available. It’s a shame the owners of this app are only wanting only high end businesses now and squeezing out the small businesses. So if you have a small businesses, do your research as there’s invoice apps that do exactly the same  thing here and more for your money.

reviews.title:
⚠️ Warning to others: 
Suddenly limited to 10 invoices only
reviews.text:
⚠️ Warning to others: After 4+ years as a loyal customer — during which they already increased prices several times — they have now suddenly cut my plan to only 10 invoices unless I pay $300/year (was $150). This was never part of the agreement when I renewed my plan. This is an unfair price hike and a clear change to the core terms. Under Australian Consumer Law, such changes can entitle customers to a refund for the unused period — which I have requested. There are free services with the exact same features — don’t waste your money here.
Companies like this never care about customers’ interests, only quick profit.

reviews.title: Price goes up, quality stays the same.
reviews.text:
I’ve been using invoice simple for 9 years with yearly price increases for about 4 years in a row. Has there been a significant shift in the product? No, it’s been pretty much the same basic invoicing app. Are they hiring a heap more staff because they are working on the app improving customer experience? I highly doubt it, given the product has barely changed. Happy to be proven wrong if a dev wants to respond to this review. 

I’m actively looking for alternatives because it’s finally hit the point where I can no longer justify the price when there are free alternatives out there that do exactly the same thing. The paid alternatives within the same price are way more advanced. I encourage everyone to do the same, this company is super greedy. The end goal seems to be to milk customers as much as possible before everyone leaves and it goes bust. The essential and plus plans are unusable for most small businesses as they only allow you to send up to 3 and 10 invoices respectively. I mean.. at less than 120 invoices a year you may as well do it manually. Devs, as providers to mostly small business, who are now no different price wise from premium providers, what are you actually offering?

reviews.title: Good but needs improving
reviews.text:
Pros: 
- user friendly via iPhone and Desktop
- fabulous support online (reply very quickly)
- quick & easy to navigate and produce an invoice or estimate/quote
Cons:
- unable to change font, style, size & limited colours
- unable to set page breaks (one line of text may flow over to second page which looks unprofessional when emailing as a PDF
- can not Duplicate an invoice via desktop 
- more features available when used via the iPhone App as opposed to desktop version
- can not add images via the desktop version
- unable to drag & drop an item to place it below/above the previous item. You need to delete that item & enter it again 
- unable to automatically calculate a payment plan: Total Due: $xxxx
10% deposit $xxxx due on xxxx 
70% progress payment $xxxx due on xxxx 
20% balance $xxxx due on xxxx
This must be added in separately 

If you plan to use this via your iPhone then it does the job but if you wld use it more via your desktop then I’d consider another App. I hate that I can’t manipulate the text to be bold, or the size of the text & colour. My invoices look quite dull. 
Hope this review helped from 
(Melbourne, Australia)

reviews.title: Love this app, 100% recommend!!!!
reviews.text: As a newly employed contractor, I had no idea how to make invoices and what information to put on them but this app makes it very simple just like the name suggests. It guides you through all the steps and all you have to do is fill in the gaps. Once I had made my first invoice I received an email from the friendly team just checking if I needed any assistance for the next one! I thought this was a lovely gesture. As it turned out, I actually did have a question and probably wouldn’t have bothered contacting them myself as with a normal app I wouldn’t normally expect a fast reply! I had an issue adding my ABN number to my invoice and the staff was extremely willing to help and got back to me very fast every time. They went through a couple options with me first before suggesting that I change my IOS settings on my actual phone and not the app and it fixed the problem! Not only does this staff understand their own app, but they understand the users requirements and their phones too! I would never have thought to change my phone settings and was very impressed and grateful that they knew to check it! I am now able to easily and quickly use the app with all my saved information each time and would never even consider another app to go through. Super friendly staff, amazing and fast communication and extremely easy to use! 100% recommend! Thank you so much for all your help! :)
